title: Targeting OsRING80 enables resistance to rice blast without developmental costs
content: Plant immunity consists of a 2-tiered system that includes a broad resistance known as pattern-triggered immunity (PTI), and a pathogen-specific resistance known as effector-triggered immunity (Jones and Dangl 2006). PTI is mediated by pattern recognition receptors localized on the cell membranes and results in reactive oxygen species (ROS) bursts, callose deposition, and transcriptional reprogramming. Plants are very cost-effective in balancing their growth and defense responses to properly react to the environment. On one hand, when plants are under stress, they direct their resources for defense responses. On the other hand, rapid growth can be accompanied by increased susceptibility to diseases (He et al. 2022).
